llm_response.reason: The site exhibits multiple scam characteristics: unclear or absent company and physical contact details, SSL certificate issues, an excessive 25% cancellation fee for order cancellation, and lack of any independent reputation or reviews online. Its only contact method is a web form (no phone/address). Search engine results yield only its own promotional pages, a common sign of transient scam sites. All these signs fit the profile of a fake online shopping scam.
